## Intent and source

Link the accepted requirement and describe the learner or maintainer outcome.

## Change surface

List affected routes, contracts, lesson/exercise IDs and versions. Describe draft, evidence and migration behavior where relevant.

## Review evidence

For learning changes, explain the scaffold gradient, fresh transfer, fixture outcomes and hint disclosure. For each content batch, link the [per-lesson manifest](https://github.com/gonzalobosque/enntor/blob/main/docs/quality/LEARNING_STANDARDS.md#review-before-release) with exact curriculum lesson IDs, newly introduced prerequisites and disclosed hint levels. For UI changes, share synthetic states with theme, viewport and reproduction steps.

## Independent review

For a content batch, record the independent comparison against the [full authoritative curriculum](https://github.com/gonzalobosque/enntor/blob/main/docs/Python_AI_Interview_Learning_Curriculum_v1.1.md), including objectives, dependencies and gates beyond the batch. List uncovered paths, known limits and any consequential decisions needed. Point reviewers to the most important source, fixture or state to inspect. Approval and merge are separate.
